name: Kheru City
description: A lively Sultai city of stone buildings, markets and waterways.

timeline.summary: Nishang, rotting from a wasting disease, rants in a tavern against the new Sultai order that makes sibsig an honor.
timeline.quote: They made being a sib an honor now and gave all our captives rest.

timeline.summary: The barkeep expels Nishang after his diseased arm grabs him and ends up thrown into the fire.
timeline.quote: "Get out," screamed the barkeep, "and don't you ever come back!"

timeline.summary: In Kheru City a woman crowns Nishang with a garland and kisses him, but his hot metal hand burns her and he apologizes.
timeline.quote: clutching the back of her arm, where Nishang's metallic fingers had brushed her, burned her.

timeline.summary: In an alley, Nishang doubts Titsui's story and learns that his friend was killed by a Sultai priest; the figure is revealed to be a rakshasa.
timeline.quote: revealing the monstrous form of a rakshasa beneath.

timeline.summary: Nishang helps a boy to his feet and realizes sibsig can feel and are like the living, but the rakshasa takes control of his body.
timeline.quote: The rakshasa was controlling him, totally and completely.

pages_say.description: A lively Sultai city of stone buildings, markets and waterways.
